item.title: Kansas legislators to meet Monday about deal to bring Kansas City Chiefs across the state line
item.description: Kansas legislators will meet Monday to take a final step toward luring the KC football team across the state line, floating bonds worth hundreds of millions so the team can build a domed stadium and an entertainment district. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas marijuana laws remain unchanged, despite Trump promoting looser regulations
item.description: President Donald Trump took the first step Thursday to reclassify marijuana, but the move won’t affect Kansans unless the state changes its laws, a law enforcement professional said. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas Supreme Court chief justice to retire by early February
item.description: Kansas Supreme Court Chief Justice Marla Luckert will step down from her position at the start of the new year and retire within weeks, she announced Friday. Continue reading ...
